title: Route TrackManagementBody's hard-delete ('wipe') path through a repository instead of calling trackDao directly (DB-1)
why: _showDeleteDialog's 'wipe' branch pulls trackDao straight out of userDatabaseProvider and calls purgeHistory/deleteTrackAndData from a widget State, bypassing the repository layer DB-1 requires. It's an inconsistency within the same method: the sibling 'archive' branch a few lines above correctly goes through curriculumActivationServiceProvider and has typed try/catch + a localized error SnackBar; the 'wipe' branch has neither a repository nor any error handling at all — if either DAO call throws, the widget has no recovery path. (The DAO methods themselves are well-built — transactional, outbox-aware — so this is a layering/testability and inconsistent-error-handling defect, not a sync-correctness one.)
recommendation: Add a track repository (or extend an existing one) with wipe/delete methods that widgets call, mirroring the 'archive' branch's service-layer pattern, including a try/catch with a localized error SnackBar for parity with the archive path.
acceptance_criteria: track_management_body.dart no longer reads userDatabaseProvider or trackDao directly.
The 'wipe' branch has the same try/catch + user-facing error handling as the 'archive' branch.
DB-1's checker (once implemented) reports zero direct DAO access from lib/features/*/presentation/.
